integrity: The claim is derived symbolically from the published definitions. Exact-arithmetic replay checks the algebra and representative finite samples. No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The deterministic identity is proved only for the intercept-only sample-mean predictor with absolute residuals and the source quantile convention. title: Exact coincidence of jackknife+ and full conformal for sample-mean prediction
